title: USAGE_MEASURED payload
description: What was delivered for one trade over one measurement window, reported from two independent sources with the variance between them. This event measures; it does not decide. The SLA_EVALUATED event decides and references this event by its payload hash.

trade_id.description: 32-byte trade identifier, identical to the escrow's trade_id.

terms_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical trade terms. Binds this event to one escrow; the program rejects evidence whose terms_hash does not match its own seed.

window.description: Measurement window, RFC 3339 UTC, start inclusive, end exclusive.

sequence.description: 1-based index of this window within the trade. Windows are contiguous; the evaluator rejects gaps.

gpu_spec_contracted.description: GPU class from the trade terms, for example H100-SXM-80GB.

sources.description: The two independent readings. provider_reported is what the provider's own billing or usage API says. telemetry is what the independent GPU telemetry and health feed observed.

gpu_hours.description: Consolidated GPU-hours delivered in the window.

uptime_ratio.description: Consolidated fraction of the window during which the contracted GPUs were available.

gpu_identity_match.description: True if the telemetry-observed GPU model and count match gpu_spec_contracted for the whole window.

method.description: Consolidation rule applied. Default is min: the lower of the two readings is taken for every quantity.

gpu_hours_rel.description: gpu_hours_abs divided by max(provider_reported.gpu_hours, telemetry.gpu_hours); 0 when both are zero.

variance.description: Disagreement between the two sources. Reported, never hidden. The SLA policy decides how much variance is tolerable.

notes.description: Free-text observations from the collector, for example a telemetry gap. Informational.

decimal.description: Non-negative decimal as a string with up to 6 fractional digits. Strings, not floats, so that canonical JSON and on-chain parsing agree byte for byte.

ratio.description: Decimal string in [0, 1] with up to 6 fractional digits.

source_id.description: Stable identifier of the feed, for example provider:acme-cloud:billing-api or telemetry:dcgm-exporter:cluster-7.

gpu_model_observed.description: GPU model string as seen by this source. Empty string if the source does not report it.

samples.description: Number of raw data points behind this reading. Zero means the source was silent for the window.

raw_digest.description: Optional SHA-256 over the raw samples as stored in the audit ledger, so a reading can be traced back to its inputs.
